name: ethos-gtm
description: Use Ethos as a remote MCP surface for GTM prospecting, enrichment, tables, agent columns, campaign analytics, and cross-channel unibox conversations without local CLI setup.

interface.shortDescription: GTM prospecting, campaigns, analytics, and a cross-channel unibox.
interface.longDescription: Use Ethos through a remote OAuth-backed MCP server. The plugin registers Ethos, routes common GTM intents, and loads the current workflow instructions from MCP resources. Find prospects, enrich contact info, build and operate campaigns, analyze performance, manage replies, and configure workflows without duplicating server-owned playbooks in the client.
defaultPrompt: Use Ethos to find RevOps leaders at US B2B SaaS companies.
Use Ethos to enrich work emails for a people table.
Use Ethos to add leads from a people table to a campaign.
Use Ethos to build an email and LinkedIn campaign from my people table.
Use Ethos to show my campaign conversations and draft a reply.
Use Ethos to compare my campaigns and identify lead segments with higher reply rates.
